derived: merged view of e5-incremental-v2-partA/B/C.json (no new measurement); rows copied verbatim
protocol: per (model, ratio, scenario): one pre-generated change sequence replayed by every path on a fresh model copy; one untimed warm-up replay, then reps timed replays; per-step time = replay time / steps; median over replays; change application included and model copy / session construction excluded on every path; speedup = batch per-step time / strategy per-step time, median over seeds with percentile bootstrap CI (2000 resamples)

paths.batch: apply change set, then full validation
paths.S1: naive k-hop: every rule re-evaluated on the induced subgraph of N_k(delta), k = max local radius = 2
paths.S2: hybrid: local rules scope-restricted, global rules recomputed in batch every step
paths.S3: witness maintenance: local rules scope-restricted, global rules through witness stores
paths.S3t: S3 with the validity threshold: stores declared invalid and rebuilt when |Delta| > 0.02 (n + m)

opsDefinition: ops per step = Holds evaluations of local rules + adjacency entries scanned inside Holds + global work units (nodes processed by BatchGlobal; nodes touched by witness maintenance)
